  <history>Layer was downloaded by ITOS from HDX. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file geodatabase. The following errors were found and fixed by ITOS: 1. Admin3 names converted to Proper Case from ALL CAPS. 2. Fixed multipart sliver error in "Seruvil". 3. Fixed spacing errors in Admin3 name "Galle4Gravets". 4. Inserted spaces before parenthetical names in 10 Admin3 names. 5. Admin3 units “Walapane” and “Nildandahinna” both had Sinhalese name "වලපනේ". Bangkok regional office has sent this correction/update: "NILDANDAHINNA ,නිල්දණ්ඩාහින්න, நீல்தண்டாஹின்ன". 6. Fixed a gap in the area between Admin4 units "Periyaneelavanai 01A" and "Periyaneelavanai 01B". The following errors were found by ITOS but are not addressed in this version: 1. Admin3 unit "Akkaraipattu" has two multipart polygons that need inspection.</history>
